questionText:

"Meenakshi, a 25-year-old concert pianist, was forced by her parents into an arranged marriage with an abusive partner. Two days before the scheduled wedding ceremony, she suddenly woke up with complete physical paralysis and total loss of sensation in her right hand and wrist, extending exactly up to the wrist crease in the shape of a glove ('Glove Anesthesia').
